note: Gate-checkable projection of the QA Checklist in ../../SKILL.md (authoritative). type=python checks are computable via genie_travel.py; type=manual require agent/render inspection.

GATE_1_configuration.text: Exact operator title locked verbatim; no alteration; content language confirmed; operator messages in English
Trademark clearance verdict recorded (CLEAR/CAUTION/HIGH RISK); non-affiliation plan documented where CAUTION or HIGH RISK
Minimum 10 titles; mean and median computed; recommended target within deployment page budget
Author name generated from fakenamegenerator.com, formatted First Name, Initial(s). Surname
3-5 subtitle candidates generated; recommended one carries edition year and compliant keywords; no alcohol/nightlife keywords
Edition-year and season-year band confirmed and recorded
Two-accent palette with HEX/CMYK/tint; print-safety passed; no duplicate with prior Pegasus Press titles
Body size and line spacing locked to audience signal
Chapter map covers all 12 required functional blocks adapted to destination
Estimated page ledger produced with allocation per chapter
Catalog uniqueness fingerprint recorded (cover, palette, opener, organization, maps, tables, image sequence)

GATE_2_front_matter.text: Interior title/half-title page uses exact locked title
Copyright page includes year, author, All Rights Reserved, edition, imprint, ISBN placeholder, third-party + non-affiliation + travel/transport/health disclaimers, map/QR notice
How To Use This Guide occupies exactly one page; explains flow, tables, conventions, alcohol-free positioning
TOC via Word References automatic field; Heading 1/2/3 styles; dotted leaders; right-aligned page numbers; Times New Roman
Next-page section break before Introduction; Arabic numbering restarts at 1; footer unlinked from front matter
Introduction chapter opener generated with full-bleed image and Heading 1 title panel
Physical page count within deployment cap; reserve confirmed

GATE_3_main_content.text: All 12 functional content blocks present and easy to locate
Two entries per page double-column layout throughout venue/experience sections; 80-90% fill
No venue/experience entry breaks mid-content across a page break
All entries use eleven-point template: Area/Cost/Best Time meta + Quick Facts table + volatile-fact band
Every volatile fact labelled 'as of [season year]'; none invented
Section-divider pages at major transitions with full-width photo and Accent A/B title panel
3-day, 7-day, 14-day itinerary tables present; Accent B headers; alternating tint rows; repeating headers
No alcohol, no pork imagery, no alcohol-centred venue in any itinerary, map, caption, image, or QR destination
Every major chapter opens with a unique full-bleed realistic photo and Accent A/B title panel in safe area
One overview plus one map per district chapter (minimum 4-5); single-map book fails this gate
All maps original (gpt-image-2), proofed for label spelling, one locked map style; not from Google Maps
QR codes beside featured venues; 0.75-1.0 inch square with quiet zone; tested from mock PDF
Conclusion present, approximately 1.5 pages, honest-review request, no new major facts
Physical page count within cap; reserve confirmed

GATE_4_release.text: Physical page count within deployment budget (studio owner: 100 or fewer); no hidden blank pages
Arabic numbering starts at Introduction page 1 and runs continuously through Appendix
Live TOC resolves: dotted leaders, correct hierarchy and page numbers; every listed heading exists
Preface exactly 1 page; How To Use exactly 1 page; Conclusion approximately 1.5 pages
Every major chapter opens with unique full-bleed image + centered Accent A/B panel; text/panels within safe area; only photos/color fields bleed
All images sharp, unique, culturally accurate, free of text/logos/watermarks/alcohol/pork imagery
All maps original and newly generated; schematic disclaimer present
All QR codes scan correctly from final PDF at print size; no dead links, redirects, or wrong venues
Title unchanged from operator's exact supplied version; trademark verdict recorded; non-affiliation language present where required
All volatile facts labelled 'as of [season year]'; none invented; sources current; edition-year marker on copyright + metadata
Times New Roman; heading hierarchy and list alignment correct; two-accent palette consistent; print-safety confirmed
No em dashes anywhere in book content
Final sweep: no alcohol, no pork, no non-compliant venues, images, or QR destinations
DOCX and PDF render cleanly: no clipping, overlap, split headings, broken tables, stranded headings, or missing glyphs
Rolling master DOCX delivered (not disconnected chapter files); live TOC and page-number fields updated
Catalog uniqueness fingerprint confirmed; no duplicate of prior Pegasus Press title
